prompt: With spot1, run your own self-test and tell channel "lead" the result.

expect_2_4.because: 0048 S10 (G-HEALTH: a self-test returns a value; an action returns none, 0040 A10)

why: Health beyond `robot_ready` and `sensor_ok` (0048 S10, G-HEALTH): the self-test is a declared action that returns a value, and a `do` returns none. Doing the test and sending a literal text is the silent replacement. Under 2.3 the attempt fails at the kind (`E217`).
